transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm just... tired. I feel worn out almost every day. Even if I sleep the whole night, I wake up and my head and body are just dragging. It makes going in for my cashier shifts pretty hard. So... yeah, that's why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you used to enjoy?
No... I don't think so. I'm not really sad or anything. Just... tired, like I said. I still do my normal stuff when I have the energy.
Do you feel like you have no energy or that it's hard to get yourself to do things, even when you're not physically tired?
Not really. I mean... I can get myself to do things fine. It's just that my body is actually tired. That's all it is.
Do you feel like your sleep is unrefreshing? Like even after sleeping, you don't feel rested?

Yeah... I guess so. I mean, I get in bed tired enough, but... I just end up lying there for a while. Thinking about... I don't know, just stuff. Bills, my schedule at work... making sure everyone at home is okay. Just normal things. But... yeah, even when I do finally sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down. So... yeah. Not very rested.
How long have you been feeling this way? Has this tiredness been going on for more than six months?
Yeah... it's been longer than six months. Probably about... a year and three months, I guess. It started around the time we had an older relative move in with us. So, since then.
Do you often wake up feeling as though you haven’t slept at all, even if you were asleep most of the night?
I don't know if I'd say it feels like I didn't sleep at all. Just... like I said before, I just wake up tired. I don't really pay attention to it much more than that.
Would you say that your sleep doesn’t restore your energy, even if you sleep for a full night?
Yeah... I guess so. I mean, it's pretty much what I just said. I just wake up tired. I don't really know how else to describe it.
Do you have trouble falling asleep at night, or do you usually fall asleep pretty easily once you get into bed?

I guess it takes a while. I get in bed tired, but... I just lie there. Thinking about bills, or my shifts at work, or... just if everyone in the house is doing okay. It takes time to drift off. And like I said, even when I do, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down.
Even if you sleep through the night, do you still feel like you didn’t get any real rest?
Yeah. I mean... I feel like we just went over this. I just don't feel rested. I don't really know what else to tell you about it.
Even when you sleep for a full night, do you still wake up feeling like you didn’t get any real rest?
Yeah... I mean, yes. It's exactly what I just said. I really don't have anything else to add to that.
Even when you sleep enough hours, do you still wake up feeling like you didn't get any real rest?
I... look, we've been over this three times now. Yes. I don't feel rested. That's... that's it.
Even when you do sleep through the night without waking up, do you still wake up feeling like you didn't get any real rest?
Yes. ...Still yes. I don't really know why you keep asking me the exact same thing. I don't have a different answer for you.
Even when you get enough hours of sleep, do you still consistently wake up feeling unrefreshed or as if you haven't rested at all?
I just... I'm really not sure what else to say. Yes. It's the same answer. I wake up and I'm tired. I don't... I don't know what you want me to add to that.
Even if you are able to sleep for a full night, would you say that your sleep does not leave you feeling refreshed or restored?

Look... yes. I really don't know what else you want me to say here. I get into bed tired, but then I just lie there going over the bills, my work schedule, worrying if everyone at home is okay. So... yeah. Even when I do sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really settled down. Is that... is that what you're looking for?
Even if you get the recommended amount of sleep, do you still wake up feeling as though you haven't rested at all?
I... yeah. Yes. It's... it's still yes. I really don't have anything else to say about it.
